 Order No. 05 Dated 08th October, 2025  I.A. No. 10516 of 2025 Heard the learned counsel for the respective parties.
This application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail to him during the pendency of this appeal.

The appellant has been convicted for the offences u/s 376-AB of the I.P.C. and Section 6 of the POCSO Act and has been sentenced to undergo R.I. for life which shall mean remainder of his natural life for the offence under Section 6 of the POCSO Act.

It has been alleged that the minor daughter of the informant was subjected to rape and it was one Jetha Hembrom who had disclosed about the involvement of the appellant in such heinous crime.
Submission has been advanced by the learned counsel for the appellant that the appellant has been implicated primarily on account of the disclosure made by Jetha Hembrom, but he has been declared hostile by the prosecution.
It has further been submitted that the appellant is custody since long and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
Learned APP has opposed the prayer for bail of the appellant.

The victim who has been examined as PW-4 has identified the appellant in the dock as the person who had subjected her to rape and such allegation finds support from the medical report, wherein several injuries were found on the private part of the victim.
The age of the victim was assessed to be 5 years.
